Caitlyn.laning: Don't force a kill early; farm CS under your turret. Poke through minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, but don't stand with the wave pushed deep toward the enemy turret. Change your route or send minions ahead through bushes and narrow passages where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap is likely to be placed.
Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early. Caitlyn deals mostly physical damage, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line connecting Caitlyn and yourself, then add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. When at least three feathers will pass through Caitlyn, recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root her.
Caitlyn.escape: Choose a route that avoids being rooted by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, then recall your prepared feathers with Xayah E Bladecaller to root Caitlyn.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for an angle to lay feathers just after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. Don't use Xayah E Bladecaller before they engage; if several enemies overlap, line up the feather recall path to look for a multi-target root. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge an enemy engage or a non-targeted ability.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you can be rooted in place and take a heavy hit from Caitlyn P Headshot, so check for traps in bushes and narrow passages and change your route. When Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker is coming, stand behind allied minions so they take the hit first.

Jhin.phase: At any stage, Jhin P Whisper and Jhin R Curtain Call are more dangerous to low-health targets, so don't overcommit when you have lost health.
Jhin.watch: Jhin W Deadly Flourish can root you shortly after you are hit by Jhin's basic attack, Jhin E Captive Audience, or an attack from one of Jhin’s allies, so move out of its line at those times. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade gets stronger with each bounce after killing a target, so stay away from low-health minions. When low on health, keep moving to avoid Jhin R Curtain Call, and use Xayah R Featherstorm against shots that are hard to dodge.
Jhin.build: Build Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin's main damage is physical and Xayah has low armor, so build armor first. Armor won't block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.combo: While Jhin is reloading, use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers in a line, add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. If you activated Xayah W Deadly Plumage, land your basic attacks, and weave basic attacks after Xayah Q Double Daggers as well to stack feathers. If you dodge Jhin's attack with Xayah R Featherstorm, counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Jhin.escape: After Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses, look for a chance to close the gap while avoiding its root. Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can close in with Xayah R Featherstorm and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. However, Xayah R Featherstorm is also a way to dodge important attacks, so don't use it first and lose the chance to evade them.
Jhin.fight: Back off when Jhin has his final shot ready, and trade while he is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots. Lay at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and empowered basic attacks, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep attacking Jhin.
Jhin.laning: Poke Jhin through minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Stand a short distance from the wave so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade doesn't bounce after killing a low-health minion. If you don't have an angle to root with Xayah E Bladecaller, save it for farming or escaping, and don't stand with the wave pushed deep toward Jhin's turret.
Jhin.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and use Xayah E Bladecaller for a multi-target root when engaging enemies overlap over the feathers. Move to dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and Jhin R Curtain Call, and save Xayah R Featherstorm for attacks that are hard to dodge. When moving forward toward Jhin, follow your frontline into range while they take Jhin E Captive Audience's traps and attacks first.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize completing a critical-strike core item that increase Xayah E Bladecaller's damage. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so if you need defenses, don't focus on only one resistance. Also consider movement speed to help close the gap.
Ezreal.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers, add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. Once Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, close in with Xayah R Featherstorm and recall the feathers left as you land with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you activated Xayah W Deadly Plumage, use it when you can actually follow up with basic attacks.
Ezreal.escape: The window to engage is right after you make Ezreal use his escape, Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Ezreal has no crowd control, so after he uses his escape, close in with Xayah R Featherstorm and look to root him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ezreal.fight: Start trades when you have at least three feathers laid. Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then close in with Xayah R Featherstorm as soon as it is down and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Repeated hits from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot make Ezreal E Arcane Shift come back sooner, so don't let that window drag on.
Ezreal.laning: Move among minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and poke Ezreal behind them with basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Cast Xayah Q Double Daggers along a line connecting Ezreal and yourself to set up the recall path. If you don't have an angle to root him, save Xayah E Bladecaller, and don't stand forward with the wave pushed deep.
Ezreal.phase: In the late game, Xayah E Bladecaller becomes stronger as critical-strike core items accumulate, but you have few escape options if you position poorly.
Ezreal.teamfight: Use vision and find an angle to close the gap instead of trading poke with Ezreal from far away. Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. Look for a multi-target root if several enemies overlap, and use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge threats and counterattack.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by keeping minions between you and him. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range before his next attack hits. When low on health, angle away from Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage's straight path as you retreat.

Aphelios.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn't hit several of you. Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. Dodge the enemy's big attacks with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Aphelios.escape: After dodging Gravitum's slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root, look for a chance to close the gap. When Aphelios isn't holding Severum, his options for escaping are limited, so stack feathers then and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Use Xayah R Featherstorm when you can dodge an enemy attack while closing the gap.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Get Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If fights last longer, consider healing reduction after building resistances.
Aphelios.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line connecting Aphelios and yourself, then add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. If you dodge an attack with Xayah R Featherstorm, immediately use Xayah E Bladecaller to catch him with the feathers left as you land.
Aphelios.fight: Trade when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep landing basic attacks, and weave passive-empowered basic attacks between abilities to stack feathers. After dodging Aphelios's slow and root, use Xayah E Bladecaller when you have an angle to recall feathers and root him.
Aphelios.laning: Poke Aphelios behind minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, but use Xayah E Bladecaller when you can line up three feathers. If Calibrum marks you, back off to preserve your health, and don't stand forward with the wave pushed deep.
Aphelios.phase: Xayah E Bladecaller becomes stronger as critical-strike core items accumulate in the mid-to-late game, but watch your positioning at every stage.
Aphelios.watch: Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites can root targets slowed by Gravitum, so immediately move out of range if you are slowed. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil adds an attack from his main weapon for each champion hit, so keep your distance from allies. When an attack is hard to dodge, avoid it with Xayah R Featherstorm and counterattack after landing with Xayah E Bladecaller.

Smolder.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line between Smolder and Xayah. Follow the ability with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to place another feather, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. If Smolder comes in with Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then look to counterattack immediately with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Smolder.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first to protect against Smolder’s main damage. However, resistance cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so close the distance as soon as it is down. Hold Xayah E Bladecaller’s root until then, and use it after laying feathers so at least three pass through Smolder. If you also dodge Smolder W Achooo!, you can approach without being slowed.
Smolder.fight: The moment after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down is your chance to fight. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage, keep auto-attacking to stack feathers, then root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Use Xayah R Featherstorm when you can dodge Smolder’s attack and counterattack.
Smolder.laning: Pressure Smolder and disrupt his farming before he builds up scaling stacks. Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Smolder even behind minions.
Smolder.phase: In the early game, Xayah has a chance to pressure Smolder before he builds up scaling stacks. In the mid game, take objectives and turrets quickly before he scales further. In the late game, Smolder’s permanent scaling puts you at a disadvantage, but Xayah E Bladecaller also becomes stronger as Xayah accumulates critical strike core items.
Smolder.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline while watching for engages, including Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap. When an engage begins, root with Xayah E Bladecaller; dodge dangerous attacks with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack. If several enemies are grouped together, line up the feather recall paths to look for an AoE root.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes when it hits a champion and slows them, making follow-up attacks easier to land. Dodge it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so step out of the fire, then re-engage. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath becomes more dangerous as Smolder scales, with true damage and an execute, so be especially careful at low health.

Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep landing basic attacks, and weave passive-empowered basic attacks between abilities to stack feathers. Ashe has no way to create distance on her own, so lay three feathers to set up a root with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Ashe.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line connecting Ashe and yourself, then add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Use Xayah E Bladecaller to root Ashe when the three feathers will pass through her and return toward you. If you dodge Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow with Xayah R Featherstorm, immediately counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller, using the feathers left as you land as well.
Ashe.escape: Look for an opening after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is coming, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then look to root her with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ashe.laning: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and trade right after it is used if you can hit her with three feathers. If you don't have that angle, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or escaping, and don't stand forward with the wave pushed deep.
Ashe.phase: Xayah has few feathers early and is weak in trades, so poke while playing to survive. At every stage, poor positioning can get you slowed by Ashe and make it difficult to create distance, so don't stay in range of her basic attacks for long.
Ashe.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and save Xayah E Bladecaller for when the enemy engages. If several enemies overlap along the feather recall path, use Xayah E Bladecaller to look for a multi-target root. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is coming, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm and immediately counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed by each basic attack, so don't stay in range of Ashe's basic attacks for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is coming, don't run straight away; change direction or dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm.

Draven.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand Draven's physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. Also consider your total health against the execute from Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line connecting Xayah and the spot where Draven's axe will land. Then add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts and recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. Using only Xayah Q Double Daggers and immediately pressing Xayah E Bladecaller will not root him.
Draven.escape: After Draven uses Draven E Stand Aside, look for a chance to close the gap without worrying about being displaced and slowed by it again. If Draven has only one axe or has lost an axe, you can approach with Xayah R Featherstorm and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. When you need to dodge Draven's attacks, use Xayah R Featherstorm to evade and counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller immediately after landing.
Draven.fight: Don't fight Draven while he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. When he has only one axe or has lost an axe, cast Xayah Q Double Daggers where it will land to make him choose whether to catch the axe and take the hit. If at least three feathers are laid, root him with Xayah E Bladecaller so he can't go catch the axe.
Draven.laning: If you don't have an angle to root him, farm safely and save Xayah E Bladecaller for escaping. Don't stand with the wave pushed deep toward Draven's turret.
Draven.phase: Draven is strong early, so avoid fights while he has two axes and don't give him a kill.
Draven.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back and watch the path Draven will take to catch an axe. Recall your feathers across that path with Xayah E Bladecaller to disrupt his axe upkeep. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge Draven R Whirling Death or an enemy engage, then root with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven is holding two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside can displace and slow Xayah, so be careful when setting up a feather recall angle. Dodge Draven R Whirling Death on its way out and back, and if you are low on health, move out of range to avoid its execute.

Jinx.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early. Jinx's main damage is physical and Xayah has low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and land your basic attacks, then lay more feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and passive-empowered basic attacks. When at least three feathers are laid and Jinx is in their recall path, root her with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you dodge one of Jinx's abilities with Xayah R Featherstorm, counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller immediately after landing.
Jinx.escape: Look for a window to close the gap when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. If Jinx W Zap! also misses, you can close in with Xayah R Featherstorm and root her with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Jinx.fight: Look to trade when Jinx pokes with Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets, since she won't have minigun attack-speed stacks. Lay at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and passive-empowered basic attacks, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root her. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, look for a chance to close the gap.
Jinx.laning: Poke Jinx behind minions with basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, and stand apart from minions so you don't also take damage from Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets. Cast Xayah Q Double Daggers along a line connecting Jinx and yourself to line up Xayah E Bladecaller's recall path. If you don't have an angle to root her with three feathers, save Xayah E Bladecaller, and don't stay for long where the wave is pushed deep.
Jinx.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Xayah E Bladecaller's damage increases as you build critical-strike items, but keep your distance because poor positioning makes it hard to escape.
Jinx.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and save Xayah E Bladecaller to root enemies when they engage. If Jinx W Zap! misses or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, look for a chance to close in and root her. Don't start a fight right after an ally dies or a turret is destroyed, because Jinx P Get Excited! increases her movement and attack speed.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rocket basic attacks also damage nearby targets, so don't stand beside minions when Jinx attacks them. Start a fight after dodging the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!. If health has been reduced, watch out for the finishing damage from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! and don't stay within its range.

Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots early. Build armor first to withstand Kai'Sa's main physical damage and basic attacks. Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker deal magic damage that armor won't block, so if you can't quickly take her down through the shield from Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, also build magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers in a line, add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root her. If you can keep landing basic attacks, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage, land a basic attack, then use Xayah Q Double Daggers followed by another basic attack to add more feathers. When Kai'Sa engages with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then use Xayah E Bladecaller.
Kaisa.escape: If you need to close the gap with Xayah R Featherstorm here, root her with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing. Usually, save Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge Kai'Sa's engage.
Kaisa.fight: Stack at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then trade while rooting her with Xayah E Bladecaller. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep landing basic attacks. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, avoid the engage with Xayah R Featherstorm and counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Kaisa.laning: Poke Kai'Sa behind minions with basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. When you think Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain is coming, stand near allied minions, and don't stay forward with the wave pushed deep.
Kaisa.teamfight: Stack feathers with basic attacks from the back, and save Xayah E Bladecaller in preparation for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct's engage. Before a fight, place Control Wards in side bushes and entry paths to prepare for Kai'Sa E Supercharge's stealth approach.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you can become the target of Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Kai'Sa P Second Skin's damage scales with your missing health, so when stacks build up, wait out their duration from outside her range. Stand near allied minions when Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain hits to spread the missiles.

Kalista.build: Kalista's main damage is physical, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kalista.combo: Lay two feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add a third with an auto attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. When you can keep auto attacking, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and weave in autos, then follow with Xayah Q Double Daggers and another auto to stack feathers. When Kalista engages with Kalista R Fate's Call, dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm and immediately use Xayah E Bladecaller.
Kalista.escape: However, the leap from Kalista P Martial Poise is tied to her auto attacks, so set up feathers to root her with Xayah E Bladecaller before going in.
Kalista.fight: When Kalista starts an auto attack, use Xayah Q Double Daggers to lay feathers for retrieval, then weave in an auto to set up a root with Xayah E Bladecaller. If Kalista engages with Kalista R Fate's Call, dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Kalista.laning: Harass Kalista behind minions with auto attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, and throw Xayah Q Double Daggers in a line so the feathers pass through Kalista on their way back. If you have no angle to root her with three feathers, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or disengaging. Don’t stand with the wave pushed far forward; if Kalista’s spears stack up, retreat behind a bush or wall to break vision.
Kalista.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from behind and save Xayah E Bladecaller for when the enemy engages. If Kalista’s support moves beside her, anticipate Kalista R Fate's Call, spread out, then dodge the engage with Xayah R Featherstorm and root with Xayah E Bladecaller. If several enemies engage on top of each other, look for an AOE root with a feather recall.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend deals heavy damage after spears have stacked in you, so if several spears are lodged, disengage and back away until they disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call throws her bound support into an engage, so spread out if the support moves beside Kalista and save Xayah R Featherstorm to evade the engage.

KogMaw.build: Build crit core items to increase Xayah E Bladecaller's damage. Against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, build magic resistance first; also consider armor against his basic attack damage. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying only on stacking health.
KogMaw.combo: Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and auto attack, then use Xayah Q Double Daggers to lay two feathers along the line between Kog'Maw and Xayah. Add another feather with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. If you used Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle or Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, follow up with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing when the feather recall path passes through Kog'Maw.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility spell to create distance, so after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, you have a chance to close the gap. If you need Xayah R Featherstorm to get closer, root with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing. Xayah R Featherstorm is also important for dodging dangerous abilities, so judge whether to use it first based on the fight.
KogMaw.fight: Close the gap and fight after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and auto attack, then use Xayah Q Double Daggers and a passive-empowered auto to lay at least three feathers and root with Xayah E Bladecaller. Kog'Maw has relatively low armor, so Xayah's physical damage is effective.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, harass Kog'Maw behind minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Start a trade when Kog'Maw is in the path of three returning feathers; if there’s no angle, save Xayah E Bladecaller. Disrupt Kog'Maw’s farming, but don’t stand forward with the wave pushed far in.
KogMaw.phase: Kog'Maw grows stronger as the game goes on, so secure objectives and towers in mid game to speed up the game, then make use of Xayah E Bladecaller empowered by her crit core items in late game.
KogMaw.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from behind, and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. Look for an AOE root with Xayah E Bladecaller when several enemies are grouped, and when your health is low, leave vision to avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and maximum-health-based damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or sidestep it, and when your health is low, leave vision to avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery. Even after killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Lucian's main damage is physical, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, lay two feathers in a line with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add a third with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. You can stack more feathers by weaving in autos after Xayah W Deadly Plumage and Xayah Q Double Daggers. If you dodged Lucian’s engage with Xayah R Featherstorm, counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller immediately after landing.
Lucian.escape: The moment after you bait out Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your window to close the gap and catch him. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to close in during that opening, then root with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Lucian.fight: After avoiding Lucian’s initial burst damage, extend the trade when his abilities are down. Look for the brief opening immediately after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, when he has no mobility, but don’t let him keep landing paired autos for long and get the ability back sooner. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage only when you can keep auto attacking.
Lucian.laning: Step out of the line behind minions to avoid Lucian Q Piercing Light. Save Xayah E Bladecaller until you have an angle for three feathers to pass through Lucian, and don’t stand forward with the wave pushed far in.
Lucian.phase: Early on, Xayah has few feathers and weak trades, so endure by dodging Lucian’s burst damage. In mid and late game, as crit core items stack, Xayah E Bladecaller gets stronger, but a poor position is dangerous, so stack feathers from behind.
Lucian.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from behind, and use Xayah E Bladecaller to root enemies who engage, including when Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. If you dodged Lucian’s engage with Xayah R Featherstorm, follow up with Xayah E Bladecaller immediately after landing. When several enemies are grouped, line up the feather recall path to look for an AOE root.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its indicator range, so don’t stand directly behind a minion when Lucian attacks it. Once Lucian R The Culling starts, he can’t change his aim, so don’t run straight backward; sidestep instead. Avoid trading when Lucian’s next two shots are empowered by an enemy support’s shield or heal, or by an ally’s immobilizing effect.

MissFortune.build: Start with Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical, and Xayah has low armor, so build armor first. Miss Fortune E Make It Rain deals magic damage, which armor does not block.
MissFortune.combo: Lay two feathers along the line between Miss Fortune and Xayah with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. If you can keep auto attacking, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and weave in autos to stack more feathers.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so after dodging the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, you have a chance to close the gap. If you need to dodge Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, leap with Xayah R Featherstorm, then retrieve the feathers you left behind with Xayah E Bladecaller to root her.
MissFortune.fight: Don’t start a fight while standing in Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Once you leave the area, stack feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller so at least three pass through Miss Fortune and root her.
MissFortune.laning: Avoid standing directly behind minions while harassing Miss Fortune through them with autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Immediately after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid the next auto empowered by Miss Fortune P Love Tap. If you have no angle to root her with three feathers, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or disengaging, and don’t stand with the wave pushed far forward.
MissFortune.teamfight: When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, don’t start a fight there; move outside the area. Stack feathers with autos from behind, and when Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, look for an angle to interrupt the channel with a root from Xayah E Bladecaller. Keep Xayah E Bladecaller available in case an enemy closes in on Xayah.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off a minion and hits targets behind it, so don’t stand in line with minions. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is dangerous when layered over the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, so move out of the area. Once the channel starts, move to the side of the cone or dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm.

Nilah.build: Nilah's main damage is physical, and Xayah has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health as well afterward. If healing makes fights drag on, get resistances first, then buy Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds.
Nilah.combo: Lay two feathers along the line between Nilah and Xayah with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add one more with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller. When Nilah engages with Nilah E Slipstream, dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm, then use Xayah E Bladecaller after landing so the feathers pass through Nilah.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t go in deep just because it’s down. Your chance to counterattack is when Nilah engages, uses Nilah W Jubilant Veil as well, and you can root her with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you have to take Nilah’s dash, use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge and counterattack.
Nilah.fight: Harass with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts before Nilah closes in. When starting a trade, set up an angle for three feathers to pass through Nilah, then root with Xayah E Bladecaller. Don’t continue trading autos while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active.
Nilah.laning: However, Xayah also has few feathers at this point and weak trades, so don’t push far enough to give Nilah an angle to engage.
Nilah.phase: In mid and late game, as crit items stack, Xayah E Bladecaller deals more damage, so stack feathers from behind and look for a root angle.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out so several allies aren’t pulled in together by Nilah R Apotheosis. Stack feathers from behind and root Nilah with Xayah E Bladecaller when she goes in; don’t use it before she engages. If you need to dodge Nilah E Slipstream, use Xayah R Featherstorm and counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Nilah.watch: Immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases and she hits in a cone, so take another step back. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, basic attacks miss, so stop auto attacking and respond with abilities or wait for the effect to end.

Samira.build: Start with Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Samira’s main damage and basic attacks.
Samira.combo: Lay two feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add one more with a passive-empowered auto, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, use Q and auto attacks after the spin ends. When Samira comes in with Samira E Wild Rush, dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm, then retrieve the feathers you left behind with E as you land.
Samira.escape: The moment after Samira E Wild Rush is down is your window to go in. Close the gap with Xayah R Featherstorm and root with Xayah E Bladecaller, making sure at least three feathers are in the recall path.
Samira.fight: Lay at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and passive-empowered autos to set up a root with Xayah E Bladecaller. Hold projectiles while Samira W Blade Whirl spins, and attack after it ends. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and nobody has died, it’s a chance to root her and fight.
Samira.laning: Throw Xayah Q Double Daggers along the line between the enemy and yourself to line up the recall path. Manage the angle Samira uses to walk in, and don’t stand with the wave pushed far toward the enemy tower.
Samira.phase: Xayah E Bladecaller gets stronger in mid and late game as crit core items stack, but poor positioning is dangerous at any stage.
Samira.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from behind and save Xayah E Bladecaller to root Samira when she engages. If Samira closes in with Samira E Wild Rush, dodge with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with E.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles, so use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos after the spin ends. If Samira closes in with Samira E Wild Rush, she can get a chance to use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so dodge the engage with Xayah R Featherstorm and reestablish your distance. Be wary of initiation abilities too, since Samira P Daredevil Impulse lets her close in immediately when you’re hit by enemy crowd control.

Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical, and Xayah has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Senna.combo: Lay two feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then retrieve them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root. If you can keep attacking, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and auto attack to stack more feathers.
Senna.escape: The moment after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is blocked by a minion is your chance to close the gap. Senna has no ability to create distance, so use Xayah R Featherstorm to approach if needed, then root with Xayah E Bladecaller when you have an angle to hit her with the feathers.
Senna.fight: Harass Senna with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts when she steps forward to collect a soul. Lay three feathers to set up a root with Xayah E Bladecaller, then continue the fight.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna’s target soul is and harass near it to stop her collecting it. If Senna hits you once, back off so you don’t take a second hit, and block Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions.
Senna.phase: If you let Senna collect souls, her range and attack damage keep growing.
Senna.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from behind, and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they go in. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back away to get vision or throw Xayah Q Double Daggers into the area. Save Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge dangerous abilities, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes in a straight line through its target and anything behind it, slowing and healing. Move out of the line between Senna and the front minion, and if Senna W Last Embrace hits you and marks you, move away from allies before the root spreads.

Seraphine.build: Build crit core items to increase Xayah E Bladecaller's damage. Against Seraphine’s main damage, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Seraphine.combo: Lay two feathers in a line toward Seraphine with Xayah Q Double Daggers, then add another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. When Seraphine is in the recall path of three feathers, root with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you dodged one of Seraphine’s abilities with Xayah R Featherstorm, you can also counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap. Seraphine has no mobility spell, so go in with Xayah R Featherstorm, then root with Xayah E Bladecaller when you can hit her with at least three feathers.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is separated from the marksman and Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and auto attack, then stack feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and passive-empowered autos before rooting with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Seraphine.laning: Harass Seraphine behind minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. Trade from an angle where three feathers pass through Seraphine; if there’s no such angle, save Xayah E Bladecaller. You have few ways to escape, so don’t stand with the wave pushed far forward.
Seraphine.phase: In mid and late game, Xayah E Bladecaller gets stronger as crit core items stack, but poor positioning is dangerous.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand spread to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore doesn’t chain through several of you. Stack feathers with autos from behind and save Xayah E Bladecaller to root when enemies engage or several enemies overlap in the recall path. Use Xayah R Featherstorm when you need to dodge Seraphine’s dangerous abilities.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets.

Sivir.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, then buy Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first since Sivir’s primary damage is physical.
Sivir.combo: After Sivir E Spell Shield is down, use Xayah Q Double Daggers to lay two feathers in a line. Follow with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to add a third, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root her. Using only Xayah Q Double Daggers and immediately pressing Xayah E Bladecaller leaves you without enough feathers to root her.
Sivir.escape: When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to root her. Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, so if you close in, catch her with Xayah E Bladecaller. If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, avoid a long chase and wait for its effect to end.
Sivir.fight: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then lay feathers so three pass through Sivir and root her with Xayah E Bladecaller. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep auto-attacking, and weave autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts between abilities.
Sivir.laning: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Sivir behind minions. If you don’t have an angle for three feathers to pass through Sivir, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or escaping. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the wave or make sure an ally is ready to catch it before leaving lane.
Sivir.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge engages or skillshots, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller right after landing. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to catch her.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the way out and the return, so if you get hit once, move out of its path on the way back. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so bait it out first, then root her with Xayah E Bladecaller. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Tristana.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line between Tristana and Xayah, then place another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts and recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller. If Tristana comes in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then look to root her by recalling even the feathers placed on landing with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Tristana.escape: The moment after you make Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump is your window to close the distance. Go in when you have feathers ready to root her with Xayah E Bladecaller, and don’t engage recklessly if Tristana R Buster Shot is still available.
Tristana.fight: Stack feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then root Tristana with Xayah E Bladecaller when at least three recall paths pass through her. If Tristana comes in with Tristana W Rocket Jump, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller. Right after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump, close the distance if Xayah E Bladecaller is ready.
Tristana.laning: Avoid Tristana E Explosive Charge’s AoE damage by not standing next to allied minions. Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Tristana behind minions, but save Xayah E Bladecaller if you don’t have an angle to hit her with three feathers. You can push the wave to make it harder for Tristana to last-hit under her turret, but don’t stay for long in a position where you’ve pushed too far forward.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is difficult to deal with once she completes her build, so play to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline and look to root Tristana with Xayah E Bladecaller when she comes in with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If you need to avoid the engage, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then follow up with Xayah E Bladecaller. If an ally goes down and Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, retreat immediately and don’t leave a squishy ally up front.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a slowing dash and can be used again if she gets a takedown, so be careful not to let her engage repeatedly. Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you back, so don’t engage recklessly when it’s ready alongside Tristana W Rocket Jump. Also watch out for the AoE damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge when you’re near allied minions.

TwistedFate.build: Xayah E Bladecaller’s damage scales with critical strike, so build critical strike core items. Build magic resistance to protect against Twisted Fate’s ability damage. Consider movement speed to help you get out of the areas he telegraphs.
TwistedFate.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line between your opponent and Xayah, add another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root the target. After activating Xayah W Deadly Plumage, keep alternating abilities and autos to stack feathers. If Twisted Fate comes in with Twisted Fate R Destiny, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack by recalling the feathers left on landing with Xayah E Bladecaller.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is used, you have less need to back off out of fear of a stun. If you use Xayah R Featherstorm to close the distance then, lay feathers and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
TwistedFate.fight: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to fight. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep auto-attacking, and weave autos between abilities to stack feathers. Xayah’s physical damage is effective against Twisted Fate’s low armor.
TwistedFate.laning: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Twisted Fate behind minions. If you don’t have an angle to root him with three feathers, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or escaping. You have few ways to escape, so don’t stay with the wave pushed deep toward the enemy turret.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline and root enemies with Xayah E Bladecaller when they engage. If you can predict where Twisted Fate R Destiny will land, wait there with vision already set up; if he is in range while casting, interrupt his movement with Xayah E Bladecaller’s root. Look for a chance to attack after the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is used.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, he can stun you with one auto, so stay out of his range. Stand behind minions to reduce the damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward first to check Twitch Q Ambush’s approach routes. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, and resistance won’t reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, so consider health instead of relying only on armor or magic resistance. Attack speed reduction is also effective because it can reduce the number of Twitch’s autos.
Twitch.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line between Twitch and Xayah, then place another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts and recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep auto-attacking Twitch. If you dodge Twitch’s attacks with Xayah R Featherstorm, recall your feathers with Xayah E Bladecaller right after landing.
Twitch.escape: Engage after leaving the slow zone from Twitch W Venom Cask. Don’t force a chase while Twitch is using the movement speed from Twitch Q Ambush to create distance. If you can close the distance with feathers already laid, catch him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Twitch.fight: When Twitch is visible, trade by using Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to lay at least three feathers and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Don’t continue trading inside Twitch W Venom Cask. When Twitch has settled in to attack, you can dodge his attacks with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Twitch.laning: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Twitch behind minions. Don’t rush to use Xayah E Bladecaller if you don’t have an angle for three feathers to pass through Twitch. If Twitch disappears from lane, alert your allies and check brush and narrow paths where you have no vision before entering.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Xayah has trouble stacking feathers and is weak in trades, so harass without pushing too far forward and staying there. Xayah E Bladecaller becomes stronger in the mid and late game as critical strike core items accumulate, but the available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage against Twitch at each stage.
Twitch.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline. When Twitch appears or activates Twitch R Spray and Pray to settle in and attack, coordinate with your allies on the target and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Spread out sideways from your allies so you don’t all take Twitch R Spray and Pray’s piercing autos. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge attacks and counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller after landing.
Twitch.watch: The cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask slows and stacks Deadly Venom, so leave immediately if it lands under you. After taking several autos, Twitch can finish you with Twitch E Contaminate even if you still have health, so create distance early. When Twitch activates Twitch R Spray and Pray, his range increases and his autos pierce, so don’t stand in a line with allies.

Varus.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, then get Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first to counter Varus’s main source of physical damage and his basic attacks. Armor does not block the magic damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver or Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to line up two feathers toward Varus, then add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. When Varus is in the feathers’ recall path, root him with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you dodge Varus R Chain of Corruption with Xayah R Featherstorm, counterattack by recalling even the feathers left behind when you land with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Varus.escape: An opening to engage comes when Varus R Chain of Corruption is down or after you dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm. You can sidestep and close the distance while Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in and root him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Varus.fight: When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and close the distance while he is slowed by the ability. When you can keep landing basic attacks, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and weave basic attacks between abilities to build feathers. Once three feathers are positioned to pass through Varus, root him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Varus.laning: Harass Varus behind minions with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts. If you don’t have an angle for three feathers to pass through Varus, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or disengaging. Don’t stand with the wave pushed deep to Varus’s turret.
Varus.teamfight: Build feathers with basic attacks from behind, and if Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, move away so the chain doesn’t spread. When the enemy engages, root them with Xayah E Bladecaller; if several enemies are grouped together, look for a multi-person root. While Varus is stronger after getting a kill or assist, avoid fighting briefly, then engage again.
Varus.watch: When Varus W Blighted Quiver has stacks on you, being hit by an ability deals bonus damage based on your max health. If you’ve taken a few basic attacks, back off and wait for the stacks to disappear. Get out of Varus E Hail of Arrows’s slow and healing reduction zone. When Varus R Chain of Corruption flies toward you, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm. If an ally is rooted, keep your distance so the chain doesn’t spread.

Vayne.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, then get Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first to protect against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn, but manage your distance so you don’t keep taking the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, which armor can’t reduce.
Vayne.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers along a line between Vayne and Xayah, then place another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts and recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller. If Vayne comes in with Vayne Q Tumble, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller right after landing.
Vayne.escape: The moment after you make Vayne use Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the distance. If Vayne E Condemn is also down, approach with Xayah R Featherstorm while watching out for a wall stun, and line up the feather recall paths to catch her with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Vayne.fight: Right after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and keep auto-attacking to stack feathers. When at least three feathers are on recall paths through Vayne, root her with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Vayne.laning: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Vayne behind minions and pressure her early farming. Position on the open side so Vayne E Condemn can’t knock you into a wall. Even while pressuring Vayne, don’t push the wave deep under the enemy turret and stay in front of it for long.
Vayne.phase: Vayne is difficult to deal with in the late game once she has her items, so secure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game.
Vayne.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths and walls, and position farther back in open areas to watch out for a wall stun from Vayne E Condemn. Stack feathers with autos; if Vayne engages with Vayne Q Tumble, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm and root her with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn can stun you by knocking you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your max health after repeated attacks on the same target, so create distance before it triggers.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo’s main damage is physical and Xayah has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor early, then get Plated Steelcaps.
Yasuo.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to place two feathers in a line, then place another with a passive-empowered auto and recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. If you can keep auto-attacking, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage, then keep stacking feathers with an auto after the ability and another after Xayah Q Double Daggers. If you dodge an engage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath with Xayah R Featherstorm, counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller right after landing.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, his knock-up stacks reset, creating an opening to engage. If Yasuo R Last Breath is also still on cooldown, close the distance with Xayah R Featherstorm and follow with a root from Xayah E Bladecaller. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again after a short time, so check your root angle before engaging.
Yasuo.fight: Start trading after lightly harassing away Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Look for the moment right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down, then lay at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and passive autos before rooting him with Xayah E Bladecaller. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again, so don’t engage just because one mobility ability is down.
Yasuo.laning: Use autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Yasuo behind minions, and aim Xayah Q Double Daggers along a line between Yasuo and Xayah. Keep the wave thinned out on your side to reduce the stepping stones Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you don’t have an angle for three feathers to pass through Yasuo, save Xayah E Bladecaller for farming or escaping.
Yasuo.phase: A bad position is dangerous at any stage of the game, so stay aware of Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s approach paths.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline and root Yasuo with Xayah E Bladecaller when he engages. Keep Xayah E Bladecaller ready before he goes in, and time Xayah R Featherstorm to dodge Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath, then recall your feathers. If several enemies are grouped together, look for an AoE root with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, watch out for the knock-up from his next tornado and dodge it by moving sideways as he approaches. Watch for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach by dashing through minions and for engages with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is placed, go around it or save your key abilities until it disappears.

Zeri.build: Build Cloth Armor first in the early game, then get Plated Steelcaps. Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal primarily physical damage, and Xayah has low armor, so build armor first.
Zeri.combo: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers to lay two feathers in a line, add another with an auto empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root Zeri. If Zeri comes in with Zeri E Spark Surge, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller when Zeri is on the recall paths of the feathers already laid and those left on landing.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri E Spark Surge is down is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Xayah R Featherstorm in open terrain away from walls, and root her with Xayah E Bladecaller when you have a recall path through her with three feathers.
Zeri.fight: The moment after you make Zeri use Zeri E Spark Surge is your chance to close the distance. Activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage when you can keep auto-attacking, and weave autos between abilities to stack feathers for Xayah E Bladecaller to recall. Root Zeri with Xayah E Bladecaller when you have an angle for three feathers to return through her.
Zeri.laning: Use Xayah Q Double Daggers and autos empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts to harass Zeri behind minions. Build a lead before Zeri gets her core items, but don’t stay with the wave pushed deep toward the enemy turret.
Zeri.phase: Xayah E Bladecaller becomes stronger in the mid and late game as critical strike core items stack, but once Zeri has her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to catch out.
Zeri.teamfight: Stack feathers with autos from the backline. If Zeri engages with Zeri E Spark Surge, dodge it with Xayah R Featherstorm, then root her with Xayah E Bladecaller. If several enemies are grouped together, look for an AoE root with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely and deals more damage when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow path. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing terrain, so don’t push her toward a wall. Zeri gains movement speed after activating Zeri R Lightning Crash, so don’t chase on foot, and watch out for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery when you’re low on health.

Ziggs.build: Prioritize completing a core item with critical strike stats, which increases Xayah E Bladecaller’s damage. To resist Ziggs’s damage, build magic resistance rather than armor, and consider movement speed to help you dodge the landing points of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Ziggs.combo: Place two feathers on a line connecting Ziggs and Xayah with Xayah Q Double Daggers, add a third with a basic attack empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller. If you can keep attacking, activate Xayah W Deadly Plumage and build feathers in this order: basic attack, Xayah Q Double Daggers, basic attack. If you dodge Ziggs W Satchel Charge with Xayah R Featherstorm, check the feathers’ recall path after landing and counterattack with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ziggs.escape: Right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your window to approach him. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield blocks your approach, go in from another direction or wait for the mines to disappear. Use Xayah R Featherstorm to close the distance, then recall your feathers and look to root him with Xayah E Bladecaller.
Ziggs.fight: Close the distance after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities, especially right after he uses up Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Lay at least three feathers with Xayah Q Double Daggers and basic attacks empowered by Xayah P Clean Cuts, then recall them with Xayah E Bladecaller to root him. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is still available, look for an opening to counterattack after dodging it with Xayah R Featherstorm.
Ziggs.laning: Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and look for an opening to fight right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave. Xayah has few ways to escape besides Xayah R Featherstorm, so don’t stand forward with the wave pushed deep.
Ziggs.phase: In the mid to late game, Xayah E Bladecaller gets stronger as you build critical strike core items, but if you position poorly, you have few ways to escape besides Xayah R Featherstorm.
Ziggs.teamfight: Build feathers with basic attacks from behind, and use Xayah E Bladecaller when the enemy engages. Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can reach you from far away, so don’t group together in one spot near an objective.
Ziggs.watch: If you’re slowed by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, you’re more likely to get hit by his other abilities, so take a route without mines or wait for them to disappear. Ziggs W Satchel Charge can knock Xayah back and move Ziggs, so keep track of whether he has used it. When you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the blast center even if you can’t get completely clear.
